name: Beijing XIAOCHENG Technology Stock Co., Ltd
summary: Beijing XIAOCHENG Technology Stock Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells integrated circuits in China and internationally. It offers smart meter SOC chip, digital electronic detonator chip, relay driver IC, and filter chips. The company also provides mineral information digital management system, enterprise management platform, energy management system, and photovoltaic management system; and Photovoltaic power generation system, smart energy system, mineral information management system, and electronic detonator system solutions.
